data.question: Did systolic blood pressure change from pre to post?

aiDisclosure.note: Statistics are calculated by deterministic code. The AI selects the method and writes the explanation.
aiDisclosure.dataSent: Question text, column names, inferred types, missing percentages, category labels (up to 15 per column) and aggregate statistics. No row-level values and no columns flagged as personal data.
aiDisclosure.rationale: Comparing paired pre and post systolic blood pressure measurements within the same subjects.

assumptions: Pairs are assumed to be matched observations. Differences are assumed approximately normal.
limitations: Results use complete cases only. Rows with a missing value in an analysed variable are excluded.
These statistics describe association in this dataset. They do not establish causation.
Unmeasured confounding can affect every association in observational healthcare data.
Interpretation not generated: The interpretation introduced numbers that are not in the results. Review the statistics directly.
